name: StellarUniversity: FurryHearts
source:
StellarUniversity: FurryHearts is a gay furry dating sim visual novel set on a college campus. You play as Leo, a freshman entering "Stellar University", where you meet four unique classmates. Each relationship offers a distinct romantic experience.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4508100/]Steam[/url]]
